correctness.rationale: PASS: Reconstructed primary DGZ orbit facts: G=PGL3(q) acts over Fq, nonfree points are confined to q²- and q³-rational short orbits, no Fq points, genus g=q(q-1)(q³-2q-2)/2+1. For a q^7 point, coprimality of 7 with 2,3 rules out short orbits. q-Frobenius commutes with G: if a free G-orbit is Frobenius-stable, Frobenius translates by a unique h with h^7=1; 7∤|G| forces h=1 and an impossible Fq point. Thus seven distinct full G-orbits must occur. Independent exact big-integer Hasse–Weil ceilings show 7|G| exceeds q^7+1+2g q^(7/2) for all six prime powers, yielding contradiction. Computations establish finite inequalities, published primary geometry supplies premises.
